name: CHARLI
summary: Built by Dennis Hong's Robotics and Mechanisms Laboratory (RoMeLa), CHARLI was the first untethered, full-size autonomous walking humanoid developed in the United States. A lightweight gait-and-actuation testbed, it won the adult-size title at RoboCup 2011 and led to RoMeLa's later THOR and ARTEMIS humanoids.
notable: First full-size autonomous walking humanoid built in the USA
